variants.name: V1_pre_fomc_long_1d
variants.rule: 1 ES contract ($50/pt), no stop/target, $16.28 per round turn. Oanda index CFD 1-minute bars as the price proxy; 'the HH:MM bar' = the first 1-minute bar with open time >= HH:MM America/Chicago on that calendar date; an entry (and each V3 signal bar) requires that bar to open within 5 minutes of HH:MM, else no trade; an exit fills at the open of the first bar >= the scheduled instant; protocol forced flat at 15:10 CT / before the weekend is the backstop. Announcement days = last day of each scheduled FOMC meeting ('... Meeting - <year>' headings of federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomchistorical<year>.htm; 'Conference Call' and '(unscheduled)' entries excluded), 104 days in 2005-2017. Enter long at the open of the 17:00 CT bar on the calendar day before the announcement day; exit at the open of the 12:55 CT bar on the announcement day.

variants.name: V2_pre_fomc_long_2d

variants.name: V3_post_fomc_continuation
variants.rule: 1 ES contract ($50/pt), no stop/target, $16.28 per round turn. Meeting - <year>' headings of federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomchistorical<year>.htm; 'Conference Call' and '(unscheduled)' entries excluded), 104 days in 2005-2017. On the announcement day compute s = sign(open(13:35 CT bar) / open(12:55 CT bar) - 1) when the 13:35 bar opens; if s != 0 enter with side s at the open of the next quoted bar (normally the 13:36 bar); exit at the open of the 15:08 CT bar the same day (forced flat 15:10 CT backstop).
